RydAR
RydAR/Data and privacy

What your drive shares.

Very little. Here is exactly what.

Camera stays on the phone

Frames are checked on the phone. Never saved or uploaded.

Anonymous curve data

After a trip, curve, direction, speed, and hour are sent together. Turn it off in Settings.

Map location is optional

Your browser may offer to center the map on you. It stays in your browser.

Map tiles come from OpenFreeMap. Questions? Open an issue.
